item.title: Democrats win the Senate, setting up divided government for remainder of Trump's term
item.description: Democrats won by making inroads in several states where they have long struggled, boosted by a challenging political environment for the GOP dominated by voter frustration over high prices.

item.title: Missourians reject ballot proposal that would have re-imposed an abortion ban
item.description: Missouri voters defeated a measure that would have banned abortion just two years after voters legalized abortion in another vote. Voters in Missouri legalized abortion two years ago but this time the abortion ban was coupled with a ban on transgender treatment for minors. Opponents said it was misleading.

item.title: Democrat Gina Hinojosa wins race for Texas governor, ousting Greg Abbott
item.description: Hinojosa, an Austin state representative, is set to be the state's first Democratic governor since 1995 and will be the state's first Latina governor.
